text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Egyptian and European cooperation council talks begin in Luxembourg on Monday; Egypt's Foreign Minister Amr Moussa joins EU ministers for the meeting, which will focus on a joint cooperation accord and Europe's role in the peace process.
- Industry Ministry studies lowering duties on raw materials.

- Egypt plans to introduce $60 billion worth of projects to investors during the economic summit in November. Industry minister says there are plans over the next four years to develop industrial output.
- President Hosni Mubarak discusses new investment projects with Saudi Prince al-Waleed bin Talal during a visit to Egypt: talks centred on tourism, agriculture and privatisation.
- Mubarak and Israeli Labour Party head Shimon Peres begin talks today in Sharm al-Sheikh to discuss the latest developments in the peace process.
- Mubarak and President Yasser Arafat discuss by telephone the peace process and Arafat praises Mubarak's role.
- Military officials detained over Sudan coup plot bid.
